name: duplicate-dialog
title: Duplicate dialog
description: Duplicate a project, document or board: a suggested name, checkboxes for what to copy with counts, and a link to the copy when it is ready.
docs: Pass sourceName, kind (a noun like project or board), options ({ id, label, count, unit, defaultChecked, disabled, reason }) and existingNames. The name starts as "Halcyon launch (copy)", or (copy 2) when that is taken, and a typed name that clashes is refused with a button that takes the nearest free one. onDuplicate({ name, include }) may return a promise: the fields lock and the button shows progress while it runs and the dialog will not close; resolve with the new item's address and the form is replaced by Copy created and an Open link, reject and the form stays as it was with the message above it and the button reads Try again. The foot says what will happen, "Copies 48 tasks and 12 files", from the counts and units. DuplicatePanel is the inside on its own.
